question: Can the strictly monotone complete-record CRT split use O(B) measured tape work per slot at payload widthQ>=B, replacing only the older quadratic metadata placeholder?
generator: Explicit groups, capacities, payload bit widths and seeds in authored source; oracle uses independent numeric division outside consumer
finite_alphabet: bit0, bit1, field delimiter, start, end, blank and template full-interval flags; 7 tapes independent of field count
measured_operations: every single-cell head step, cell read/write, metadata template/counter scan and return, ripple increment, full payload bit/delimiter read/write, zero-template scan/return, input/output rewind and workspace erase
exception_repair_scope: The monotone split has no guarded nonlinear rotation and no exceptional set. Upstream actual repair must complete before known-zero invalid records are deleted; no full guarded CRT acceptance is implied.
limitations: Scalar descriptor/template setup has a separate polynomial bound; this finite tape model is not a formal transition table. Guarded rotations, layouts, sparse keys/repair and full multiplication remain separate.
